subject: Audit log ingest rates & evidence delivery schedule for HIPAA pilot
thread_body:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@carelabs.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@carelabs.com
Date: Sun, 5 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit log ingest rates & evidence delivery schedule for HIPAA pilot

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Legal and Security asked for two clarifications before procurement will sign:

1) For the pilot (7 nodes ingesting structured events + attachments), how do you price audit-log ingest and storage? We expect ~10M events/day and up to 500GB/day of compressed attachments for 30 days.
2) What does evidence delivery look like if we need a SOC-like package (logs + attestations) on a quarterly cadence? Is that an extra line item or included in the residency/HSM bundle?

Can you also confirm whether evidence exports can be delivered to our S3 or must go through Redwood-managed transfer?

Appreciate a ballpark cost split and the expected lead time for delivery/attachments.

Best,
Elena
Head of Security Operations
CareLabs

-----

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@carelabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 May 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit log ingest rates & evidence delivery schedule for HIPAA pilot

Hi Elena — thanks, and great questions. High-level answers first, then internal notes for our team below.

Short answers:
- Audit-log ingest: we charge audit-log processing based on ingestion throughput (GB/day) plus a small per-event parsing fee when events exceed schema thresholds. For your numbers (~10M events/day + 500GB/day attachments), the incremental ingest cost is dominated by attachment storage and egress for evidence exports.
- Evidence delivery: quarterly evidence packs are priced as a professional-services + bandwidth line item unless bundled in a residency/KMS package. For pilots we typically offer one complimentary evidence export and then price subsequent quarterly exports.
- Export destination: we can push exports directly to customer-managed S3 (preferred) or deliver via Redwood-encrypted transfer to our secure bucket and share temporary credentials.

I attached an "audit-evidence-spec.xlsx" that maps event classes to parsing tiers and a draft SOW for the evidence delivery cadence.

Next steps: Ben/Laura — can you confirm conservative pricing ranges (pilot scale) and recommended crediting approach (one-time pilot credit vs month-to-month offset)? Dev — any constraints on S3 transfer + timeline for automating quarterly pack generation?

Thanks,
Rachel
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Rachel.Kim@redwood.com

Attachment: audit-evidence-spec.xlsx

-----

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 May 2028 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit log ingest rates & evidence delivery schedule for HIPAA pilot

Agree with Rachel's summary. Rough pilot numbers (ballpark, to be refined after schema review):
- Ingest processing: $0.004 per 1k events parsed (events with simple schema), $0.012 per 1k for heavy parsing (NLP/enrichment).
- Attachment storage: $0.02 per GB/day for short-term pilot retention (30 days). Longer retention moves to standard storage tiers.
- Evidence export (quarterly): professional services time estimated 8–16 hours + transfer costs. For sales math we model a $2,500 line item for a quarterly export after the complimentary pilot export.

Crediting approach recommendation:
- Offer a $15k pilot credit that customers can apply to any of: ingest fees, attachment storage, or first evidence export.
- For pilots that convert, amortize credits across the first 3 invoice months rather than upfront refunds.

I'll put these numbers in a quick pricing worksheet and share.

Ben
Director, Account Economics | Redwood Inference

-----

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 May 2028 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit log ingest rates & evidence delivery schedule for HIPAA pilot

Dev notes on implementation/timeline:
- S3 delivery: we support customer-managed S3 with role-assumed put-object; requires cross-account IAM role setup. Typical setup time: 3 business days if customer infra team is responsive.
- Automation: we have a quarterly-pack job that renders logs + evidence bundle and signs the manifest with our key. For initial pilot I'll need 2 weeks to add the CareLabs event schema mapping and test export.
- Attachments: transfer pipeline can push attachments; 500GB/day is heavy but doable in pilot if we throttle and parallelize jobs. We should advise CareLabs to gzip attachments prior to ingest for cost savings.

I'll build a slim SOW that calls out the 2-week integration window and a one-time export test milestone.

Dev
Principal Engineer, Integrations | Redwood Inference

-----

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@carelabs.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@carelabs.com, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 May 2028 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit log ingest rates & evidence delivery schedule for HIPAA pilot

Thanks — this is helpful. Procurement prefers an explicit line item for quarterly evidence exports (we need to track budget) rather than burying it in the residency bundle. Would Redwood be open to the following concession?

- Pilot: complimentary initial evidence export; $2,000 per subsequent quarterly export for the first year (discounted from your $2,500 estimate).
- Credit: apply a $12,000 pilot credit that can be used for ingest/storage/evidence exports, amortized over the first two invoices.
- Delivery: must be able to push to our S3; please include cross-account role setup in the SOW and one test export milestone.

Can you confirm acceptance so procurement can prepare PO language? Also share the slim SOW for review.

Best,
Elena

-----

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@carelabs.com>, procurement@carelabs.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 May 2028 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit log ingest rates & evidence delivery schedule for HIPAA pilot

Elena — we can accept those terms with small tweaks:

- Evidence export: $2,000 per quarterly export the first 12 months; after that standard PS pricing applies.
- Pilot credit: accept $12,000 amortized over the first two invoices (we'll show as credits on invoice 1 and 2).
- Delivery: will push to customer S3; Dev will own cross-account role setup and we will include the setup + one test export as a milestone in the SOW.

I'll attach the slim SOW (redwood-sow-draft.pdf) with milestones and the invoice/credit language. If that works, procurement can issue a PO referencing deal CL-2321 and we'll schedule the integration kickoff for the week after PO.

Thanks — Rachel

Attachment: redwood-sow-draft.pdf
